source: ECMWF open data AIFS single deterministic forecast GRIB2 product
units_policy: surface geopotential in m2 s-2, converted to metres by the mapping's declared 1/9.80665 scale
time_policy: published at the analysis step (0-hour file) only, together with the land-sea mask (discipline 2, category 0, parameter 0, level type 1); both are read from the cycle's own step-0 object, which a window starting past f000 fetches in addition, and carried to every forecast valid time under the composition's source_cycle_analysis_broadcast clock, which refuses a step-0 object from any other cycle
member_policy: AIFS single is deterministic; no member identity exists
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
